Terms of use

Calendar Corrector · Effective 27 October 2026 · Last reviewed 30 October 2026

The short version

Calendar Corrector is licensed under Apple’s standard End User License Agreement. This page adds a few plain-language points. Nothing here limits your rights as a consumer.

Who these terms are with

Rayn Rosnuk, who makes apps as Loon Softworks (Ontario, Canada). Contact support@loonsoftworks.com.

Check the original for anything important

The app copies and changes events from schedules published by others: employers, schools, teams and calendar providers. Those sources can be wrong, late or change without notice, and the app can only show what it receives. Updates also depend on your device, its settings and your internet connection. If a shift, exam, appointment or deadline matters, confirm it with the original schedule.

Your fixes are your choices

Rules you create, such as renaming, hiding, moving or changing times, apply to future events automatically. Review what they do, especially rules that hide events.

Holidays

Holiday dates are built into the app for convenience and may not match your employer’s, school’s or province’s official calendar.

Not affiliated

Calendar Corrector is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Apple, Google, 7shifts, Deputy, When I Work, Homebase or any other service it works with. Their names and trademarks belong to their owners and are used only to describe compatibility.

Subscriptions

Unlimited renews automatically through your Apple account until you cancel it in your Apple account settings. Payment, renewal, refunds and cancellation are handled by Apple.

Liability

To the extent the law allows, the app is provided as is, and the developer isn’t liable for missed or incorrect events or what follows from them, as set out in Apple’s licence agreement. Nothing here limits rights you have under consumer protection laws where you live, including Quebec’s Consumer Protection Act.

Changes and law

We post changes on this page with a new date. These terms are governed by the laws of Ontario and Canada, except where the law where you live gives you the right to rely on it.

Contact

support@loonsoftworks.com. Also available in French; both versions are equally authoritative.
